% `only marks` with no mark draws `*` marks: without a mark key, with
% `mark=none`, and after the axis' `no markers` (behaviour Z15, generator fuzz).
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[no markers, legend pos=north west]
\addplot[only marks] coordinates {(0,0) (1,1) (2,0.5)};
\addlegendentry{plain}
\addplot[only marks, red, mark=none] coordinates {(0,1.5) (1,2) (2,1.8)};
\addlegendentry{none}
\addplot+[only marks, mark=square*] coordinates {(0,2.5) (1,2.8) (2,3)};
\addlegendentry{cycle}
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
